other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Case study set in a brick industry / brick kiln company production processes
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: This research presents the methodology and results of implementing energy efficiency management in the brick industry

one_line: Empirical case study implementing ISO 50001 energy-efficiency management at a brick-manufacturing plant (Ladrillera Sagitario S.A.) with kiln firing and air-drying production lines; brick/ceramics is not one of the eight registered Corpus B sectors.
